messages:
Ravi (People Ops): Quick live thread post-all-hands 1: clarifying hybrid/offsite logistics and desk access. Pls chime in if anything missing. Link in main doc: https://redwood.company/confluence/hybrid-ops.

Olivia (Eng): For team offsites: if we rent a shared workspace (WeWork style), who signs the contract?

Ravi (People Ops): Ops signs for centrally funded offsites. If the team pays from Team Events budget, team lead signs but Ops legal reviews any vendor contract > $5k. Send to workplace-procure@redwood.

Ben (Sales): Sales folks visiting customers: can we reserve a hub desk the same day we travel in?

Ravi (People Ops): Yes, book via the Workspace app. If arrival is late-night, request a day-pass and note arrival time.

Clara (Design): Contractors: can they be added to desk pools for a week?

Ravi (People Ops): Contractors can be added for short-term access with manager sponsor; no permanent desk unless contractor is on a >6 month engagement and approved by People Ops.

Marta (Finance): Quick reminder: use correct expense codes: EXP-OFFSITE-TEAM, EXP-TRVL-SALES, EXP-INTV-CAND. Keep allocation notes for mixed trips.

Delivery-bot: FYI: SF hub receiving closed tomorrow 4pm-8pm for maintenance. Plan shipments accordingly. :package:

Olivia (Eng): Can we get a short checklist for managers for travel approvals? Saves me chasing receipts.

Ravi (People Ops): On it 1 I'll add a one-page manager checklist and a simple booking flow to Confluence by Friday and ping this thread when live. Thanks all!
